fields.roleHelp: “Getting ready” is for you and your team: guests don’t see it on the invitation.
fields.name: Name
fields.nameHelp: As guests will see it, such as “Saint Hripsime Church”.
fields.addressHelp: Shown to guests. The invitation can be published once a venue has an address.
fields.mapUrlHelp: A link to the place on a map, starting with https://. Guests see it as “Directions”.
fields.arrivalHelp: In the event’s time zone, {{timeZone}}, wherever your guests are. Leave both empty for no set time.

errors.mapUrl: Use a web address starting with https:// or http://. Guests wouldn’t be shown anything else.
errors.arrivalPair: Fill in both the date and the time, or leave both empty.
errors.timeSkipped: The clocks go forward at this time, so it doesn’t exist on that day in this time zone. Choose another time.
errors.capacity: Use a whole number from 1 to 100,000, or leave it empty.
errors.cantClear: Once set, this can be changed but not emptied.

form.lead: Guests who open the invitation see a change at once.
form.goneTitle: This venue is no longer on the event

list.title: Venues
list.lead: Where your guests go. The invitation shows each venue with its address and directions, and can be published once one has an address.
list.mapUnusable: The map link isn’t a web address, so guests aren’t shown it. Edit the venue to correct it.
list.directory: The venue directory, kept by Aveline staff

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.body: Guests will no longer see it on the invitation.

problems.forbidden: Your role on this event can’t change its venues. The event’s owner can change your role.
problems.missing: This venue is no longer on the event. The list has been reloaded.
problems.eventMissing: This event is no longer available.
problems.conflict: That can’t be done in the event’s current state. Reload the page to see it as it is now.
problems.inUse: This venue can’t be removed while the running order, a table or a released seat still points to it. Move or dismiss them first.
problems.check: Some details weren’t accepted. Check them and try again.
problems.hasAnswers: Guests have already answered for this venue, so it can’t be removed: their answers stay with it. You can still correct its details.
problems.guestFacing: Guests have answered, chosen or been seated for this venue, so it has to stay shown to guests. Keep what happens there as it was.
problems.hallRetired: That hall has left the directory, so its choice was dropped. The name and address you see are kept: press Add to use them as typed.

directory.title: The venue directory
directory.lead: Halls every host can start a venue from. Aveline staff keep it: only they can add, correct or retire a hall, or say who runs it. Venues already copied from a hall keep their copy.
directory.empty: The directory has no halls yet.

pick.label: Start from the directory (optional)
pick.help: Fills in the name and address, which you can still change.
pick.copied: Its coordinates and capacity are copied to this venue when you add it.
pick.refused: Your role can’t read the directory. Type the venue in below.

form.body: Every host sees this. Only Aveline staff can save it.
form.name: Name
form.operatorHelp: Aveline’s curated venue vendors. Each hall has one; a vendor can run several.
form.noOperators: The list of vendors can’t be read with your role, so who runs this hall stays as it is.

retireDialog.title: Retire {{name}}?
retireDialog.body: Hosts stop seeing it. Venues already copied from it keep their copy. No read shows a retired hall again, so it can’t be brought back from this page.

refused.staffOnly: Only Aveline staff can change the directory. Your role can read it and start a venue from it.
refused.gone: That hall is no longer in the directory. The page has been reloaded.
refused.operatorRefused: That vendor can’t run a hall any more. The page has been reloaded: choose another.
refused.rateLimited: Too many tries. Wait a minute, then try again.
refused.noAnswer: No answer came. It may have been saved: check the list, then try again.
refused.other: This wasn’t accepted. The reason, in English:

directory.readRefused: Your role can’t read the directory.
